reason: S-0006-46a1: the delegate sandbox has no network (by harness design), so npm cannot resolve registry.npmjs.org and the ESLint/Prettier devDependencies cannot be installed there. Host-only fix: install them and produce package-lock.json on the host, then re-delegate so the worker does the config, scripts, .envrc, guard test and CI offline. Same pattern as the Docker signals S-0002..S-0005.
